subject: Draft MAP milestone: POC environment gates, SSO/KMS & peering — action summary
messages:
From: Lucas Meyer <lucas.meyer@syncrohealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@syncrohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: environment gates for the POC (peering/SSO/KMS)

Monica — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can align timelines: 

- We want to kick the POC the week of Jan 11. Target POC window: 3 weeks (12 Jan - 30 Jan) with a mid-point demo.
- Environment must be reachable from SyncroHealth's AWS account: VPC peering or shared VPC is fine.
- IP allowlist: we'll maintain a short-lived list; please confirm expected source IPs/egress ranges.
- SSO: we use Okta (SAML). We'll need an IdP metadata file and a test user.
- Secrets/KMS: we use customer-managed KMS keys for any secrets stored on your side.

Can you confirm who owns each gate on your team and any blockers that typically delay this work? Also requested the mutual action plan spreadsheet you mentioned.

Thanks,
Lucas
Lucas Meyer
IT Engineering Manager, SyncroHealth
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Meyer <lucas.meyer@syncrohealth.com>
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@syncrohealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: environment gates for the POC (peering/SSO/KMS)

Lucas — appreciate the clear list. Attaching a concise MAP draft (MAP-v2-POC-milestones.xlsx) that maps owners, target dates, and dependencies. High-level answers inline: 

- Target window acknowledged: Jan 12 start is doable if infra pre-reqs finish by Jan 7. Proposed target close date for MAP milestone set to 2027-01-07.
- VPC peering: Redwood requires either cross-account peering or a routed VPC (we can accept peering + route table entries). Network team will need your VPC ID, CIDR ranges, and a proposed peering name.
- IP allowlist: Source ranges we use for control plane callbacks are 34.198.0.0/16 and 54.210.0.0/16 (we'll provide final list). For dedicated egress we can provide fixed NAT IPs on request.
- SSO/SAML: We support SP-initiated SAML; please send IdP metadata XML. Test user with Okta role "poc_tester@syncrohealth.com" is sufficient.
- Secrets/KMS: We support customer-managed KMS on Private deployments; for hosted POC we'll propose envelope encryption with customer-managed keys if you bring the KMS.

Owners (proposed in MAP):
- Network / peering: SyncroHealth (Lucas) + Redwood infra ops (Ben Carter) — network checklist attached.
- SSO/SAML integration: SyncroHealth IdP (Alicia) + Redwood SSO lead (Karthik Iyer).
- Secrets/KMS: SyncroHealth security (Alicia) + Redwood security (Dev Patel).

Next steps:
1) Please review attached MAP-v2 and confirm owners by EOD Thu Dec 16.
2) Share IdP metadata and a non-prod VPC ID for peering.
3) Ben and Dev will sync with your network/security on Fri Dec 17 (30-min).

I'm copying Ben and Karthik to confirm Redwood-side commitments.

Best,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucas Meyer <lucas.meyer@syncrohealth.com>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@syncrohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Draft MAP milestone: POC environment gates, SSO/KMS & peering — action summary

Quick note from infra ops:

- I'll own the peering checklist from Redwood's side. Blocking items we typically see: missing route table entries, overlapping CIDRs, and missing security group rules for the management plane. If Syncro provides VPC ID + CIDR + contact for peering accept, I can create the peering request the same day.
- IP allowlist: confirm whether you need per-region endpoints. If yes, we'll provide regional IP sets.
- For DNS resolution across peered VPCs, we recommend adding the private hosted zone delegation (if you want internal name resolution). Let us know if you prefer IP-only.

Dev — can you confirm the exact KMS flow we want to propose (bring-your-own-key vs envelope)? For a hosted POC, envelope + CMK in customer's account is the lower operational friction. Also, I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Fri Dec 17 11:00 PST — that works for me.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood
Attachment: network-reqs-compact.pdf (network checklist, routing + SG template)
From: Lucas Meyer <lucas.meyer@syncrohealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@syncrohealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP milestone: POC environment gates, SSO/KMS & peering — action summary

Thanks everyone — confirmed:
- I'll populate the MAP owners column by EOD today.
- Sending IdP metadata + non-prod VPC ID in a separate email (Alicia will send those).
- Fri Dec 17 11:00 PST works for the sync (invitation coming from our side).

Appreciate the clear owners list. If we can get peering accepted and basic SSO smoke test done by Jan 5, we'll be on track for your Jan 12 POC start.

Thanks,
Lucas

Notes:
- Attachments referenced are stubs (MAP-v2-POC-milestones.xlsx, network-reqs-compact.pdf).
- Thread captures the typical sales -> infra ops -> security handoff for a MAP milestone focused on environment pre-reqs (VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML, secrets/KMS).
